dataset: Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions
license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
attribution: Hongn, A., Bosch, F., Prado, L., & Bonomini, P. (2025). Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions (version 1.0.1). PhysioNet. DOI:10.13026/he0v-tf17.
signalMeaning: Empatica device-derived average heart rate from PPG; not raw PPG, ECG ground truth, or Garmin output
transformations: Extracted original header plus first 61 readings; values and CRLF preserved
Replay chooses latest causal reading at five-second capture times
Replay rounds HR to the existing integer sample contract; raw values remain in this CSV
No study condition was converted to Garmin stress or movie-emotion labels
privacy: Published de-identified source; no demographic or questionnaire files downloaded
timezoneInterpretation: UTC per dataset README; source header omits zone; generic adapter treats naive headers as UTC
